title: Physics of Language Models: Part 4.2, Canon Layers at Scale where Synthetic Pretraining Resonates in Reality
abstract: arXiv:2611.24963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Do standard benchmarks see the architectural differences that matter? We study it with 64 from-scratch pretraining runs of Transformers and three linear-model families at 1.3-8B parameters on 1-2T Nemotron-CC tokens, at a cost of roughly 100k USD per 8B run.   In academic-scale pretraining (1.3B parameters, 100B tokens), architectural differences can all but disappear when the models are carefully tuned. Instead, at 1-2T tokens they become measurable: Canon layers, which add local token mixing, consistently improve Transformers, saving about 30% of pretraining tokens for the same MMLU accuracy at 8B. We also introduce GLA5 and GDN2, which improve gated linear attention and Gated DeltaNet with low-rank output gates. Surprisingly, with Canon, the simplest linear model, gated linear attention, matches Gated DeltaNet and outperforms Mamba2 even at 8B/1T. translated_title: 语言模型的物理学：第4.2部分，在合成预训练与现实共鸣的规模下研究Canon层
translated_abstract: 标准基准测试能否察觉到真正重要的架构差异？我们通过64次从零开始的预训练实验来研究这一问题，涵盖Transformer和三个线性模型家族，参数规模为1.3B至8B，训练数据为1-2T的Nemotron-CC词元，每次8B规模的训练成本约为10万美元。在学术规模的预训练中（1.3B参数、100B词元），经过精心调优后，架构之间的差异几乎可以完全消失。而在1-2T词元的规模下，这些差异变得可以测量：Canon层通过增加局部词元混合，能够持续提升Transformer的性能——在8B参数下，达到相同MMLU准确率可节省约30%的预训练词元。我们还提出了GLA5和GDN2，通过低秩输出门控分别改进了门控线性注意力和Gated DeltaNet。令人惊讶的是，加上Canon之后，最简单的线性模型——门控线性注意力，即使在8B/1T的规模下也能匹敌Gated DeltaNet并超越Mamba2。因此，Gated DeltaNet和Mamba2的额外机制可能只是起到了……
tldr: 在1-2T词元的大规模预训练中，Canon层通过局部词元混合持续提升Transformer性能（8B下节省约30%预训练词元），且加上Canon后最简单的门控线性注意力模型即可匹敌Gated DeltaNet并超越Mamba2。
en_tdlr: At 1-2T token scale, Canon layers with local token mixing consistently improve Transformers (saving ~30% pretraining tokens at 8B), and with Canon, the simplest linear model—gated linear attention—matches Gated DeltaNet and outperforms Mamba2 even at 8B/1T.
